answer_1.quote: RAVEN, a unified architecture for question answering over video, audio, and sensor inputs... We release AVS-QA [...] with auto-generated QA pairs.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to open-ended, closed-ended, multiple-choice, and true/false questions

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics (GPT based) follow prior work...

answer_3.quote: For each candidate pair, the Critic applies an ensemble of instruction-tuned LLMs to assess QA quality... where each score corresponds to one of five axes: answerability, hallucination robustness, modality grounding, specificity, and semantic relevance.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation on a randomly selected subset of 300 question-answer pairs from AVS-QA. Two expert annotators independently reviewed each sample...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assigned ratings based on accompanying video, audio, and sensor data using a 5-point Likert scale matching LLM scorer axes
